description: Source code for a Windows-specific tool that retrieves and converts symbol files from a Microsoft symbol server into Breakpad's format, including classes and functions for symbol file location, callback handling, and file conversion.

classes.name: GUIDOrSignatureIdentifier
classes.description: Handles parsing and initialization of GUID or signature identifiers from strings.

classes.name: MSSymbolServerConverter
classes.description: Manages locating, downloading, and converting symbol files from a Microsoft symbol server.

classes.name: AutoSymSrv
classes.description: RAII class for managing SymInitialize and SymCleanup calls.

classes.name: AutoDeleter
classes.description: Manages automatic deletion of files when out of scope.

methods.name: InitializeFromString
methods.description: Parses a string to initialize GUID or signature identifier.

methods.name: LocateFile
methods.description: Locates a file on the symbol server based on provided identifiers.

methods.name: LocatePEFile
methods.description: Locates the PE (executable) file associated with a missing symbol.

methods.name: LocateSymbolFile
methods.description: Locates the symbol (PDB) file for a missing symbol.

methods.name: LocateAndConvertSymbolFile
methods.description: Downloads, converts, and optionally retains symbol and PE files, producing a Breakpad-compatible symbol file.
